depends_on.description: IDs of other CodeTasks in the same MechanicPlan that this task depends on. The codegen ledger blocks this task until every dep is 'done'.
depends_on.title: Depends On

headers.description: Whitelisted public engine headers that the generated code may include. Allowed: ptv/api/IMechanic.h, ptv/api/IBehaviour.h, ptv/api/IDialogueHook.h, ptv/ecs/World.h, ptv/math/Math.h, plus <entt/entt.hpp>, <nlohmann/json.hpp>, <glm/glm.hpp>.
headers.title: Headers

interface.description: Name of the abstract interface the generated module implements: 'IMechanic' | 'IBehaviour' | 'IDialogueHook'.
interface.title: Interface

ControllerBinding.description:
The controller control that activates an input-driven mechanic.

Set by the MechanicPlan agent (from the prompt when it names a binding,
otherwise a VR-best-practice default), validated deterministically for
conflicts, and materialized into the entity's ``mechanic_bindings.params``
at scene compile so the running mechanic reads ``control`` + ``hand`` from
its params and checks the live ``InputSnapshot``.

Layout constraints (enforced by the binding validator): A/B live on the
RIGHT controller only; X/Y live on the LEFT controller only.
ControllerBinding.title: ControllerBinding

ControllerControl.description:
Which physical control on the Meta Quest 3 Touch Plus controller
drives an input-driven mechanic. ``none`` means the mechanic is not
directly input-driven (e.g. a wave timer, health system).
ControllerControl.title: ControllerControl

base_builtin_id.description: When classification is 'builtin+config_code_edit', the id of the built-in mechanic whose SOURCE should be copied and edited into the new generated mechanic (e.g. 'builtin.locomotion.teleport'). The code-generation stage injects that source into the agent's context so it edits rather than rewrites from scratch.
base_builtin_id.title: Base Builtin Id

binding.description: Controller binding for input-driven mechanics. None (or control='none') for mechanics that are not directly driven by a controller control. Validated for conflicts before scene compile and materialized into scene.json params.

builtin_id.description: When classification is 'builtin' or 'builtin+config', the id of the reused built-in mechanic (e.g. 'builtin.grab').
builtin_id.title: Builtin Id

code_task.description: Present when classification == 'generate' or 'builtin+config_code_edit' (the new C++ module to author).

config.description: Free-form config passed to the built-in mechanic.
config.title: Config
